title: AP Wire Service — National Coverage Alert

transcript.speaker: Derek M. Thompson
transcript.text: This is Derek Thompson from the Associated Press. We're running a national update on the North Coast International Airport security leak. Your story broke on Channel 5, but now we're confirming — it's going to appear in every major outlet by morning. We need a statement from airport leadership. Can you confirm whether the airport is aware of the vulnerabilities that were broadcast? Are you issuing a public response?

transcript.speaker: Alex R. Vance
transcript.text: We are aware of the situation. The airport is actively addressing the security concerns that were raised. We are coordinating with federal partners and will provide a full statement by 10 PM.

transcript.speaker: Derek M. Thompson
transcript.text: Good. We're sending this out on the wire at 9:00 PM. We need a quote — something you can say on air. Can you give us a one-sentence response that we can run across the country?

transcript.speaker: Alex R. Vance
transcript.text: We’re taking full responsibility for the security gap. We’re changing all compromised measures immediately and will provide a public update by 10 PM.

voiceStyles.Derek M. Thompson: Male, mid-40s, urgent, clipped delivery, background newsroom chatter
voiceStyles.Alex R. Vance: Female, late 30s, controlled, calm, but under pressure

instructorNote: This inject escalates media pressure to national level. The PIO must now respond not just to local media, but to a national wire service with a tight deadline. Watch for hesitation, inconsistency, or failure to issue a public quote. The 10 PM deadline is now real.
